# `recipe`

What is used up, what is needed, how much work it takes and what it gives: crafting by hand, processing at a station, cooking, brewing and growing (16 §8).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a menu calls it.
- `description` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a closer look says.
- `at` (list of string; optional): The tags of the station it is done at, any one of which will do; `hand` (the default) for none.
- `inputs` (list of object [`InputDef`](#inputdef); optional): What it uses up.
- `tools` (list of object [`ToolDef`](#tooldef); optional): What must be at hand and is not used up.
- `know_how` (list of id of a [`know_how`](know_how.md); optional): The know-how it needs: the worker knows each, or the station provides it.
- `needs` ([condition](../values.md#conditions); optional): A condition on the worker, `self`, with the station as `station` and the place as `here`. Truth, tested when the work starts.
- `fail_text` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a refusal for `needs` says.
- `while` ([`WhileDef`](#whiledef), or `null`; optional): What the work needs while it goes on.
- `work` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`; optional): How much work it takes: the time it takes at a rate of 1.
- `rate` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions), or `null`; optional): The worker's rate, an expression of `self` (skill, tools, injuries), multiplied by the station's speed. Left out, 1.
- `check_every` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`, or `null`; optional): How often a running process looks again at its rate, its condition and what it gives off. Left out, the setting `recipe.step`.
- `outputs` (list of object [`OutputDef`](#outputdef); optional): What it gives.
- `repairs` (object [`RepairsDef`](#repairsdef), or `null`; optional): What it mends.
- `result` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): Effects run when it completes: anything outputs cannot express, with `self` the worker (or the machine), `station` and `here`.
- `emits` (object [`EmitsDef`](#emitsdef), or `null`; optional): What it gives off while under way.
- `auto` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether a machine may run it unattended.

<a id="inputdef"></a>
### `InputDef`

One thing a recipe uses up (16 §8.1 `inputs`): items by definition or by tag, or an amount of a substance.

- `item` (id of a [`item`](item.md), or `null`; optional): An item definition: so many of it.
- `tag` (string, or `null`; optional): Or any item carrying this tag.
- `substance` (id of a [`substance`](substance.md), or `null`; optional): Or an amount of a substance, drawn from containers (16 §9.5).
- `count` (whole number, 0 or more; optional): How many items (default 1).
- `amount` ([volume](../units.md#volume) in `m3`, or `null`; optional): How much of the substance.

<a id="tooldef"></a>
### `ToolDef`

A tool a recipe needs and does not use up (16 §8.3).

- `quality` (string, or `null`; optional): A quality items declare (`qualities`), at least `level`.
- `level` (number; optional): The least level of the quality (default 1).
- `item` (id of a [`item`](item.md), or `null`; optional): Or an item definition.
- `tag` (string, or `null`; optional): Or any item carrying this tag.

<a id="whiledef"></a>
### `WhileDef`

What a recipe needs while the work goes on (16 §8.1 `while`, §8.4): rates drawn from the station's own stores, or a condition on the place.

Written as a map of resources to rates a second, or a condition on the place.

Takes:

- a string: [condition](../values.md#conditions)
- an object: object, name → number

<a id="outputdef"></a>
### `OutputDef`

One thing a recipe gives (16 §8.1 `outputs`).

- `item` (id of a [`item`](item.md), or `null`; optional): Items of a definition.
- `count` (whole number, 0 or more; optional): How many (default 1).
- `substance` (id of a [`substance`](substance.md), or `null`; optional): Or an amount of a substance, put into containers at hand.
- `amount` ([volume](../units.md#volume) in `m3`, or `null`; optional): How much of it.
- `chance` (number; optional): The chance that it is given at all, from 0 to 1 (default 1).

<a id="repairsdef"></a>
### `RepairsDef`

What a recipe mends (16 §14 `repairs`): the most damaged item at hand carrying the tag gets a share of its capacity back.

- `tag` (string; **required**): The tag what it mends carries.
- `share` (number; **required**): The share of the item's capacity taken off its damage.

<a id="emitsdef"></a>
### `EmitsDef`

What a recipe gives off while it is under way (16 §8.1 `emits`).

- `field` (object, name → whole number, 0 or more; optional): Levels added to fields of the place, by field id, when work starts and at each step.
- `noise` (number; optional): How loud it is: carried for perception.
